title: Nvidia joins Nscale's $2B Series C

sources.quote: The funding round was supported by Astra Capital Management, Citadel, Dell, Jane Street, Lenovo, Linden Advisors, Nokia, NVIDIA, and Point72.

explain: Nvidia invested again in Nscale's $2 billion Series C, which valued Nscale at $14.6 billion. Nvidia's own amount was not disclosed.
